mapper.sql: FROM product p LEFT JOIN supplier_product sp ON sp.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.supplier_id = sp.supplier_id LEFT JOIN purchase pu ON pu.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = pu.customer_id

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category, p.unit_price, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase sold WHERE sold.product_id = p.product_id) AS sold, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_service ps JOIN purchase serviced ON serviced.purchase_id = ps.purchase_id WHERE serviced.product_id = p.product_id) AS service_accepted, s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, c.customer_id, c.customer_name
mapper.select: WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase sold WHERE sold.product_id = p.product_id) ORDER BY p.product_id, s.supplier_id, c.customer_id
WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY s.supplier_id, c.customer_id
